newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MMS to hold western Gulf lease sale August 27.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MMS to hold western Gulf lease sale August 27.

text.p: The U.S. Minerals Management Service said Thursday that it would hold a sale for leases in the western Gulf of Mexico on August 27 in New Orleans.
The agency will be offering 4,710 blocks covering about 25.7 million acres in the Gulf off Texas and Louisiana.
The blocks, located from nine to 223 miles offshore, are in water depths ranging from 8 meters to more than 3,000 meters, with 3,200 tracts in water deeper than 200 meters.
Some of the tracts are in the Western Gap, an area beyond the U.S. Exclusive Economic Zone, and will be subject to special bidding procedures, MMS said.
